[center][b][color=#f2c14e]BUT DU JEU[/co:
[center][b][color=#f2c14e]GOAL OF THE GAME[/color][/b][/center]
Reduce the enemy hero's health points (HP) from [b]25[/b] to [b]0[/b].
There is [b]no maximum HP[/b]: healing can push a hero above their starting HP (number in [color=#7dff8a]green[/color]).

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]WHO GOES FIRST?[/color][/b][/center]
A coin stamped with each player's avatar is flipped at the start of the game: the side it lands on decides who goes first.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]ENERGY[/color][/b][/center]
Energy ([color=#5ab4f0]blue gem[/color]) is your action points. On your first turn you have [b]1[/b] maximum energy, then [b]+1 each turn[/b] up to [b]10[/b]. It is fully refilled at the start of your turn.
Each card costs the amount of energy shown at its top left. Unused energy is lost at the end of the turn.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]HOW A TURN WORKS[/color][/b][/center]
1. [b]Draw choice[/b]: you reveal the top 3 cards of your deck and keep [b]one[/b] (click or keys 1 to 3); the other 2 go back to the bottom of the deck. Until you have chosen, you cannot play. (If only one card is left, you draw it directly.) The [b]View board[/b] button (or the [b]Tab[/b] / [b]V[/b] key, which switches between the choice and the board) lets you look at your hand and the board before choosing.
2. You play cards as long as you have energy. You can also [b]discard[/b] a card for free: hover it, then click the small red [b]X[/b] (two clicks to confirm).
3. Your minions attack (once each).
4. You end your turn ([b]End Turn[/b] button or [b]Space[/b] key).

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]DECKS[/color][/b][/center]
You and your opponent play [b]exactly the same 100-card deck[/b] (59 different cards, 1 to 4 copies each), shuffled differently. Starting hand: 3 cards (4 for the player who goes second). Maximum hand: 9 cards (extra cards drawn are destroyed). Maximum board: 6 minions.
If your deck is empty, each draw deals increasing [b]fatigue[/b] damage (1, 2, 3...).

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]MINIONS[/color][/b][/center]
A minion has [b]Attack[/b] (sword) and [b]HP[/b] (heart). It cannot attack on the turn it is played (“Zzz”), unless it has [b]Charge[/b].
When two minions fight, each deals its damage to the other. An attacked hero does not strike back. A minion at 0 HP dies.
Some minions have an [b]Ongoing effect[/b]: as long as they are in play, they buff your other minions or act at the start / end of your turn.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]SPELLS[/color][/b][/center]
A spell produces an immediate effect, then disappears. Some spells require you to choose a target.

[center][b][color=#c9a0ff]ENCHANTMENTS[/color][/b][/center]
An enchantment ([color=#c9a0ff]purple frame[/color]) stays in play in the zone between the heroes ([b]2 max[/b] per player). It acts as long as it isn't destroyed:
• [b]permanent[/b] effect (e.g. “Your minions have +1 Attack”): the bonus disappears if the enchantment is destroyed;
• effect at the [b]start[/b] or [b]end of your turn[/b] (e.g. “restores 2 HP to your hero”).
It has [b]no HP[/b] and cannot be attacked: only destruction cards remove it (Dispel, Purification, Spellbreaker).

[center][b][color=#c9a0ff]GRAVEYARD AND DECK[/color][/b][/center]
Dead, played, destroyed, discarded cards and cards removed from the deck go to their owner's [b]graveyard[/b]. Some cards make use of it: Hungry Ghoul, Gravedigger, Resurrection, Grave Pact.
Others change the decks: [b]Archive Purge[/b] removes 1-cost cards from yours (to draw stronger cards afterwards), [b]Sabotage[/b] removes expensive cards from the opponent's deck.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]VS AI[/color][/b][/center]
Four levels: [b]Apprentice[/b], [b]Knight[/b], [b]Warlord[/b] (anticipates your answers) and [b]Challenger[/b]: it plays like the Warlord and starts with [b]5 HP[/b] and [b]1 card[/b] more. The higher the level, the bigger the rewards.
Each level you beat gets a [b]green check mark[/b] in the menu and unlocks a title, an avatar border, a card back and a board.
[b]Inferno[/b]: the strongest AI, with [b]infinite HP[/b]. Deal as much damage as you can before you fall: your best score goes into the [b]Inferno[/b] tab of the leaderboard.
In a game, the [b]Auto end turn[/b] box (under the timer) ends your turn as soon as you have nothing left to play.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]MULTIPLAYER[/color][/b][/center]
Main menu > [b]Multiplayer[/b]: [b]create a game[/b] (it appears in the list for all online players) or [b]join[/b] an open game from the list. You can also invite an online friend. Everything goes through the official server: no port or IP address to configure.
Leaving a game in progress counts as conceding.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]GOLD COINS, SHOP AND BATTLE PASS[/color][/b][/center]
Each game earns [b]gold coins (G)[/b]: more for a win, a little for a loss (the longer you held out, the more), almost nothing for conceding. First win of the day: [b]+20 G[/b]. Games shorter than 45 seconds earn nothing.
The [b]Shop[/b] sells card backs, boards and avatar borders; you then equip them in Customization (from your profile).
A [b]season[/b] lasts one month. Each game advances the [b]battle pass[/b] (30 levels): G, card backs, borders, a board and a title are obtained automatically and are yours forever. All season 1 players will receive the [b]Pioneer[/b] title when it ends.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]FAIR PLAY[/color][/b][/center]
The server deals each game, then fully replays it to validate it: wins, G, XP and statistics are only granted for verified games. Beyond 10 games per day against the same opponent, games no longer count.

[center][b][color=#f2c14e]CONTROLS[/color][/b][/center]
• [b]Play a card[/b]: a 1st click selects it (golden outline), a 2nd click plays it (if it needs a target, then click the target). Right-click or Esc: deselect.
• [b]Sort your hand[/b] (bottom right): Manual (drag a card to move it without playing it), Cost, Health or Attack.
• Game [b]duration[/b]: timer under the End Turn button.
• Online [b]rematch[/b]: either player can offer it, the other accepts or declines.
• [b]Click one of your minions[/b] (green border), then an enemy: attack.
• [b]Right-click[/b] or [b]Esc[/b]: cancel targeting.
• Hover a minion to see its full card.
• Under each hero: [b]Deck[/b] (contents of your remaining library, without the draw order) and [b]Graveyard[/b] (dead, played, destroyed or discarded cards, for both players).
• [b]Esc[/b]: closes the open window, otherwise opens the settings (volume, shortcuts, language...), also available via the [b]gear[/b] at the bottom left of the main menu. [b]Shift[/b] (held): speed up animations.
